svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make ten, five a side, on a flat jig. Drawn: side B end module.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chords: SHS 40 x 40 x 3, 1,380 mm; centres 1,143 mm apart. The top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: chord is the top rail, 1,100 mm above the floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Verticals: SHS 40 x 40 x 4, 1,103 mm between the chords, flush with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each end. Diagonal and knee rail: SHS 30 x 30 x 3; knee rail 550

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mm above the floor. All joints welded all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Toe board: 2 mm sheet, 150 mm above the floor, on the inner edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Splice holes: three pairs of 13 mm holes through each end vertical,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at 60, 560 and 1,060 mm up, for six M12 bolts per splice.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bearer cleats: 8 x 80 x 80 mm plate on the chord's inner face at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each end, reaching 40 mm below it, four 13 mm holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End modules: 10 mm foot plate 150 x 160 mm under the chord.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side B: 6 mm shelf brackets for the carriage rail on both verticals.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flat within 3 mm; about 35 kg (two people).
